text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...I'm searching for the right words.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: What can I say? How can I express these feelings?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The cheers of the fans, my nerves on
edge, the
wind rushing by me... I'd never
experienced any of
it before.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
As I was running, I prayed it would never
end...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: That's how much it filled my heart!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Indeed. My heart's still pounding!
choice_data_list: すごく感動したんだな
すごく感動したんだね

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I want to run more. I want to run in so
many more
races!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Woo! Let's raise the sails and set off for
the next
port, Trainer! ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oops!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, let me take a seat. What were you
saying?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Due to her unique circumstances, Fine
Motion has
much less training than the
other racers.
choice_data_list: もう少し走ることに慣れよう

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Potential alone isn't going to carry her
through
races. I explain to her that we'll
work on her
fundamentals and enter
races based on how
training goes to
steadily build more experience.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hmmm, you make some good points...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Understood! I'll build up my stamina
until I can
run without my heart beating
out of my chest!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh? I could do that, but...
choice_data_list: 目標にしたいレースも考えておいて

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Even if we just stick to training, I'll be
happy. As
long as I get to run. ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hmmm...
choice_data_list: 明確な指針があるほうが伸びやすい

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I'll put some thought into it.
While I'm busy
running, of course!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I'm so happy. ♪ I'm going to run
the full
circumference of the world in
these three years!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we begin Fine Motion's junior
year by
focusing on her training and
development.
